body {
font-family: 'Inter', Sans-Serif !important;
}
/* Variables */
:root {
--tomsguide-secondary: #1F69FF!important;
}
.slice-container-trending {
--trending-label-color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1)!important;
--trending-highlight-color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1)!important;
--trending-scrollbar-color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1)!important;
--trending-background-color: #F5F8FF; /*also used by the children*/
}
/* Custom styles for rebrand investigation */
/*Commercial savings custom style*/
body .article .flw-full-width-commercial-img .widget-commercial-lead{
margin-bottom:30px;
display: contents;
}
body .article .flw-full-width-commercial-img .widget-commercial-lead .widget-commercial-logo{
width:100%;
height: auto;
}
/* Author Block */
.author__toggle-icon, .author__toggle-text {
color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1);
}
/* Breadcrumbs */
.breadcrumb ol li a {
color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-2);
}
/* Images */
.hero-image-wrapper img,
.vanilla-image-block img {
--image--border-radius: 10px;
}
/* Boxout */
.fancy_box-title {
border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0!important;
background: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
}
.fancy_box-title:before {
display: none;
}
.fancy_box_body {
border-radius: 0 0 15px 15px;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_1);
}
/* Section Headers */
.article-body__section {
text-transform: unset;
border-bottom: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
}
.article-body__section span {
border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
padding: 10px 20px;
line-height: 1.5em;
background-color: var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
}
/* Section Headers for review-article */
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section) {
position: relative;
border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
color: var(--brand-color-white);
}
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section),
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::before,
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::after {
background-color: var(--brand-color-1);
}
@media (min-width: 1000px) {
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::before {
left: -60px;
bottom: 0;
}
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::after {
right: -60px;
bottom: 0;
}
}
/* Byline Article Type Flag */
:is(.article, .review-article, .static-article, .news-article) .byline {
padding: 5px 10px;
--byline-chip--border-radius: 4px;
}
/* Sticky Jumplinks */
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"] {
border-bottom: none!important;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"].active {
background: var(--jumpto-underline-color);
border-radius: 20px;
margin: 5px 10px;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"].active a {
color: white!important;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Variants:Floating"] > div {
border: none !important;
border-radius: 15px !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_1) !important;
}
/* Topic tag links */
#articleTag nav a {
background: white !important;
border: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1) !important;
border-radius: 20px;
padding: 10px 15px !important;
}
/* Blockquote */
#article-body figure blockquote {
float: unset;
width: auto;
margin: 1.5em 0 !important;
border-top: none;
border-bottom: none;
border-left: 5px solid var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
padding: 0 0 0 20px;
}
#article-body figure blockquote:before {
display:none;
}
#article-body figure blockquote > p {
font-size: 1.25em;
}
/* Person */
.person--separator {
border: none;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales-color-1);
border-radius: 15px;
padding: 20px;
}
.person--separator .person__role {
margin-top: 6px;
}
/* Author Block */
.author {
border: none !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales-color-1);
border-radius: 15px;
padding: 20px;
}
.author__heading {
display: flex !important;
flex: auto;
justify-content: start;
flex-direction: row !important;
align-items: center !important;
flex-wrap: wrap;
gap: 0px;
}
.author__role {
order: 100;
flex: 100%;
}
/* Dividers */
#article-body hr {
border-bottom: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
margin: 1em 0;
}
/* Reviews */
.pretty-verdict {
margin-top: 45px!important;
border: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1)!important;
border-radius: 15px!important;
}
.pretty-verdict__heading-container {
top: -55px!important;
background: var(--flexi-secondary_color_1)!important;
color: white!important;
border-radius: 15px 15px 0 0!important;
}
/* Livefeed */
.widget-content-parsed-live-feed .article-body .wcp-item-content {
border-color: unset !important;
border-style: unset !important;
border-width: unset !important;
border-top: unset !important;
border-radius: 15px !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales-color-2);
}
/* Tables */
.table__wrapper--inbodyContent .table__head__heading {
background: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1)!important;
color: white!important;
}
.table__wrapper--inbodyContent .table__body__row:nth-child(2n) .table_body__data {
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_2)!important;
}
.table__wrapper--inbodyContent.table__wrapper--divider .table__head__heading:first-of-type, .table__wrapper--inbodyContent.table__wrapper--divider .table_body__data:first-of-type {
border-right: none!important;
}
/* Header adjustments */
@media (max-width: 699px) {
body.sticky-navigation .primary-nav {
width: 100% !important;
max-width: 100%;
}
}
[aria-label="Main navigation"] {
max-width: 1280px !important;
}
[aria-label="Main navigation"] > [data-component-name],
[aria-label="Main navigation"] > #auth-in-nav-header { /*no :is when selector has an #id - messes up the rules order*/
padding: 0 !important;
margin: 0 !important;
border: none !important;
}
/* the site config key is ignored */
[data-component-name="Nav:Desktop"] {
--nav-narrow-width: 1200px!important;
}
.meganav-item--top-level + .meganav-item--top-level {
padding-left: 10px;
}
[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead:Logo"] {
--logo-height-desktop: 32px;
--strapline-padding-bottom: 0;
--strapline-font-size: 9px;
position: relative;
}
[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead:Logo"] a > *:last-child {
position: absolute;
bottom: -12px;
font-weight: 700;
line-height: 12px;
letter-spacing: 0.1px;
vertical-align: middle;
text-transform: uppercase;
color: #64748B;
}
/* fix: unresponsive to siteConfig changes */
[data-component-name="Social:Icons"] {
display: none !important;
}
/* fix: we don't want to switch off viafoura, but need to hide the bell */
[data-component-name="Viafoura:Notification:TrayBell"] {
display: none !important;
}
[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead:Newsletter"] *:has(svg) {
display: none !important;
}
[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead"] [data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead:Logo"] ~ * * {
font-size: 14px !important;
}
[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead"] [data-component-name="Region:LocaleSelector"] ~ *:not(.search-box) {
position: relative;
}
[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead"] [data-component-name="Region:LocaleSelector"] ~ *:not(.search-box)::before {
content: '';
background-color: #E5E5E5;
width: 1px;
height: var(--nav-item-line-height, 20px);

body {
font-family: 'Inter', Sans-Serif !important;
}
/* Variables */
:root {
--tomsguide-secondary: #1F69FF!important;
}
.slice-container-trending {
--trending-label-color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1)!important;
--trending-highlight-color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1)!important;
--trending-scrollbar-color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1)!important;
--trending-background-color: #F5F8FF; /*also used by the children*/
}
/* Custom styles for rebrand investigation */
/*Commercial savings custom style*/
body .article .flw-full-width-commercial-img .widget-commercial-lead{
margin-bottom:30px;
display: contents;
}
body .article .flw-full-width-commercial-img .widget-commercial-lead .widget-commercial-logo{
width:100%;
height: auto;
}
/* Author Block */
.author__toggle-icon, .author__toggle-text {
color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1);
}
/* Breadcrumbs */
.breadcrumb ol li a {
color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-2);
}
/* Images */
.hero-image-wrapper img,
.vanilla-image-block img {
--image--border-radius: 10px;
}
/* Boxout */
.fancy_box-title {
border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0!important;
background: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
}
.fancy_box-title:before {
display: none;
}
.fancy_box_body {
border-radius: 0 0 15px 15px;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_1);
}
/* Section Headers */
.article-body__section {
text-transform: unset;
border-bottom: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
}
.article-body__section span {
border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
padding: 10px 20px;
line-height: 1.5em;
background-color: var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
}
/* Section Headers for review-article */
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section) {
position: relative;
border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
color: var(--brand-color-white);
}
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section),
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::before,
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::after {
background-color: var(--brand-color-1);
}
@media (min-width: 1000px) {
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::before {
left: -60px;
bottom: 0;
}
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::after {
right: -60px;
bottom: 0;
}
}
/* Byline Article Type Flag */
:is(.article, .review-article, .static-article, .news-article) .byline {
padding: 5px 10px;
--byline-chip--border-radius: 4px;
}
/* Sticky Jumplinks */
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"] {
border-bottom: none!important;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"].active {
background: var(--jumpto-underline-color);
border-radius: 20px;
margin: 5px 10px;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"].active a {
color: white!important;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Variants:Floating"] > div {
border: none !important;
border-radius: 15px !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_1) !important;
}
/* Topic tag links */
#articleTag nav a {
background: white !important;
border: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1) !important;
border-radius: 20px;
padding: 10px 15px !important;
}
/* Blockquote */
#article-body figure blockquote {
float: unset;
width: auto;
margin: 1.5em 0 !important;
border-top: none;
border-bottom: none;
border-left: 5px solid var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
padding: 0 0 0 20px;
}
#article-body figure blockquote:before {
display:none;
}
#article-body figure blockquote > p {
font-size: 1.25em;
}
/* Person */
.person--separator {
border: none;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales-color-1);
border-radius: 15px;
padding: 20px;
}
.person--separator .person__role {
margin-top: 6px;
}
/* Author Block */
.author {
border: none !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales-color-1);
border-radius: 15px;
padding: 20px;
}
.author__heading {
display: flex !important;
flex: auto;
justify-content: start;
flex-direction: row !important;
align-items: center !important;
flex-wrap: wrap;
gap: 0px;
}
.author__role {
order: 100;
flex: 100%;
}
/* Dividers */
#article-body hr {
border-bottom: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
margin: 1em 0;
}
/* Reviews */
.pretty-verdict {
margin-top: 45px!important;
border: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1)!important;
border-radius: 15px!important;
}
.pretty-verdict__heading-container {
top: -55px!important;
background: var(--flexi-secondary_color_1)!important;
color: white!important;
border-radius: 15px 15px 0 0!important;
}
/* Livefeed */
.widget-content-parsed-live-feed .article-body .wcp-item-content {
border-color: unset !important;
border-style: unset !important;
border-width: unset !important;
border-top: unset !important;
border-radius: 15px !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales-color-2);
}
/* Tables */
.table__wrapper--inbodyContent .table__head__heading {
background: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1)!important;
color: white!important;
}
.table__wrapper--inbodyContent .table__body__row:nth-child(2n) .table_body__data {
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_2)!important;
}
.table__wrapper--inbodyContent.table__wrapper--divider .table__head__heading:first-of-type, .table__wrapper--inbodyContent.table__wrapper--divider .table_body__data:first-of-type {
border-right: none!important;
}
/* Header adjustments */
@media (max-width: 699px) {
body.sticky-navigation .primary-nav {
width: 100% !important;
max-width: 100%;
}
}
[aria-label="Main navigation"] {
max-width: 1280px !important;
}
[aria-label="Main navigation"] > [data-component-name],
[aria-label="Main navigation"] > #auth-in-nav-header { /*no :is when selector has an #id - messes up the rules order*/
padding: 0 !important;

}
/* the site config key is ignored */

body {
font-family: 'Inter', Sans-Serif !important;

/* Variables */
:root {
--tomsguide-secondary: #1F69FF!important;
}
.slice-container-trending {
--trending-label-color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1)!important;
--trending-highlight-color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1)!important;
--trending-scrollbar-color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1)!important;
--trending-background-color: #F5F8FF; /*also used by the children*/
}
/* Custom styles for rebrand investigation */
/*Commercial savings custom style*/
body .article .flw-full-width-commercial-img .widget-commercial-lead{
margin-bottom:30px;
display: contents;
}
body .article .flw-full-width-commercial-img .widget-commercial-lead .widget-commercial-logo{
width:100%;
height: auto;
}
/* Author Block */
.author__toggle-icon, .author__toggle-text {
color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1);
}
/* Breadcrumbs */
.breadcrumb ol li a {
color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-2);
}
/* Images */
.hero-image-wrapper img,
.vanilla-image-block img {
--image--border-radius: 10px;
}
/* Boxout */
.fancy_box-title {
border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0!important;
background: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
}
.fancy_box-title:before {
display: none;
}
.fancy_box_body {
border-radius: 0 0 15px 15px;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_1);
}
/* Section Headers */
.article-body__section {
text-transform: unset;
border-bottom: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
}
.article-body__section span {
border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
padding: 10px 20px;
line-height: 1.5em;
background-color: var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
}
/* Section Headers for review-article */
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section) {
position: relative;
border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
color: var(--brand-color-white);
}
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section),
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::before,
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::after {
background-color: var(--brand-color-1);
}
@media (min-width: 1000px) {
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::before {
left: -60px;
bottom: 0;
}
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::after {
right: -60px;
bottom: 0;
}
}
/* Byline Article Type Flag */
:is(.article, .review-article, .static-article, .news-article) .byline {
padding: 5px 10px;
--byline-chip--border-radius: 4px;
}
/* Sticky Jumplinks */
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"] {
border-bottom: none!important;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"].active {
background: var(--jumpto-underline-color);
border-radius: 20px;
margin: 5px 10px;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"].active a {
color: white!important;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Variants:Floating"] > div {
border: none !important;
border-radius: 15px !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_1) !important;
}
/* Topic tag links */
#articleTag nav a {
background: white !important;
border: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1) !important;
border-radius: 20px;
padding: 10px 15px !important;
}
/* Blockquote */
#article-body figure blockquote {
float: unset;
width: auto;
margin: 1.5em 0 !important;
border-top: none;
border-bottom: none;
border-left: 5px solid var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);

body {

/* Variables */
:root {
--tomsguide-secondary: #1F69FF!important;
}
.slice-container-trending {
--trending-label-color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1)!important;

}
/* Custom styles for rebrand investigation */
/*Commercial savings custom style*/
body .article .flw-full-width-commercial-img .widget-commercial-lead{
margin-bottom:30px;
display: contents;
}
body .article .flw-full-width-commercial-img .widget-commercial-lead .widget-commercial-logo{
width:100%;
height: auto;
}
/* Author Block */
.author__toggle-icon, .author__toggle-text {
color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1);
}
/* Breadcrumbs */
.breadcrumb ol li a {
color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-2);
}
/* Images */
.hero-image-wrapper img,
.vanilla-image-block img {
--image--border-radius: 10px;
}
/* Boxout */
.fancy_box-title {
border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0!important;
background: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
}
.fancy_box-title:before {
display: none;
}
.fancy_box_body {
border-radius: 0 0 15px 15px;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_1);
}
/* Section Headers */
.article-body__section {
text-transform: unset;
border-bottom: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
}
.article-body__section span {
border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
padding: 10px 20px;
line-height: 1.5em;
background-color: var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
}
/* Section Headers for review-article */
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section) {
position: relative;
border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
color: var(--brand-color-white);
}
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section),
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::before,
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::after {
background-color: var(--brand-color-1);
}
@media (min-width: 1000px) {
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::before {
left: -60px;
bottom: 0;
}
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::after {
right: -60px;
bottom: 0;
}
}
/* Byline Article Type Flag */
:is(.article, .review-article, .static-article, .news-article) .byline {
padding: 5px 10px;
--byline-chip--border-radius: 4px;
}
/* Sticky Jumplinks */
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"] {
border-bottom: none!important;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"].active {
background: var(--jumpto-underline-color);
border-radius: 20px;
margin: 5px 10px;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"].active a {
color: white!important;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Variants:Floating"] > div {
border: none !important;
border-radius: 15px !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_1) !important;
}
/* Topic tag links */
#articleTag nav a {
background: white !important;
border: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1) !important;
border-radius: 20px;
padding: 10px 15px !important;
}
/* Blockquote */
#article-body figure blockquote {
float: unset;
width: auto;
margin: 1.5em 0 !important;
border-top: none;
border-bottom: none;
border-left: 5px solid var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
padding: 0 0 0 20px;
}
#article-body figure blockquote:before {
display:none;
}
#article-body figure blockquote > p {
font-size: 1.25em;
}
/* Person */
.person--separator {
border: none;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales-color-1);
border-radius: 15px;
padding: 20px;
}
.person--separator .person__role {
margin-top: 6px;
}
/* Author Block */
.author {
border: none !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales-color-1);
border-radius: 15px;
padding: 20px;
}
.author__heading {
display: flex !important;
flex: auto;
justify-content: start;
flex-direction: row !important;
align-items: center !important;
flex-wrap: wrap;
gap: 0px;
}
.author__role {
order: 100;
flex: 100%;
}
/* Dividers */
#article-body hr {
border-bottom: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
margin: 1em 0;
}
/* Reviews */
.pretty-verdict {
margin-top: 45px!important;
border: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1)!important;
border-radius: 15px!important;
}
.pretty-verdict__heading-container {
top: -55px!important;
background: var(--flexi-secondary_color_1)!important;
color: white!important;
border-radius: 15px 15px 0 0!important;
}
/* Livefeed */
.widget-content-parsed-live-feed .article-body .wcp-item-content {
border-color: unset !important;
border-style: unset !important;
border-width: unset !important;
border-top: unset !important;
border-radius: 15px !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales-color-2);
}
/* Tables */
.table__wrapper--inbodyContent .table__head__heading {
background: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1)!important;
color: white!important;
}
.table__wrapper--inbodyContent .table__body__row:nth-child(2n) .table_body__data {
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_2)!important;
}
.table__wrapper--inbodyContent.table__wrapper--divider .table__head__heading:first-of-type, .table__wrapper--inbodyContent.table__wrapper--divider .table_body__data:first-of-type {
border-right: none!important;
}
/* Header adjustments */
@media (max-width: 699px) {
body.sticky-navigation .primary-nav {
width: 100% !important;
max-width: 100%;
}
}
[aria-label="Main navigation"] {
max-width: 1280px !important;
}
[aria-label="Main navigation"] > [data-component-name],
[aria-label="Main navigation"] > #auth-in-nav-header { /*no :is when selector has an #id - messes up the rules order*/
padding: 0 !important;
margin: 0 !important;
border: none !important;
}
/* the site config key is ignored */
[data-component-name="Nav:Desktop"] {
--nav-narrow-width: 1200px!important;
}
.meganav-item--top-level + .meganav-item--top-level {
padding-left: 10px;
}
[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead:Logo"] {
--logo-height-desktop: 32px;
--strapline-padding-bottom: 0;
--strapline-font-size: 9px;
position: relative;
}
[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead:Logo"] a > *:last-child {
position: absolute;
bottom: -12px;
font-weight: 700;
line-height: 12px;
letter-spacing: 0.1px;
vertical-align: middle;
text-transform: uppercase;
color: #64748B;
}
/* fix: unresponsive to siteConfig changes */
[data-component-name="Social:Icons"] {

}
/* fix: we don't want to switch off viafoura, but need to hide the bell */
[data-component-name="Viafoura:Notification:TrayBell"] {
display: none !important;
}
[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead:Newsletter"] *:has(svg) {
display: none !important;
}
[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead"] [data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead:Logo"] ~ * * {

content: url('data:image/svg+xml,<svg width="14" height="12" viewBox="0 0 14 12" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M12.9028 1.96528C12.9028 1.29687 12.3559 0.75 11.6875 0.75H1.96528C1.29688 0.75 0.75 1.29687 0.75 1.96528M12.9028 1.96528V9.25696C12.9028 9.92534 12.3559 10.4722 11.6875 10.4722H1.96528C1.29688 10.4722 0.75 9.92534 0.75 9.25696V1.96528M12.9028 1.96528L6.82641 6.21873L0.75 1.96528" stroke="%23011535" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>');

[data-component-name="SiteHeader:Masthead:SearchBar"] svg,

body {
font-family: 'Inter', Sans-Serif !important;
}
/* Variables */
:root {
--tomsguide-secondary: #1F69FF!important;
}
.slice-container-trending {
--trending-label-color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1)!important;
--trending-highlight-color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1)!important;
--trending-scrollbar-color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1)!important;
--trending-background-color: #F5F8FF; /*also used by the children*/
}
/* Custom styles for rebrand investigation */
/*Commercial savings custom style*/
body .article .flw-full-width-commercial-img .widget-commercial-lead{
margin-bottom:30px;
display: contents;
}
body .article .flw-full-width-commercial-img .widget-commercial-lead .widget-commercial-logo{
width:100%;
height: auto;
}
/* Author Block */
.author__toggle-icon, .author__toggle-text {
color: var(--flexi-brand-color-1);
}
/* Breadcrumbs */
.breadcrumb ol li a {
color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-2);
}
/* Images */
.hero-image-wrapper img,
.vanilla-image-block img {
--image--border-radius: 10px;
}
/* Boxout */
.fancy_box-title {
border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0!important;
background: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
}
.fancy_box-title:before {
display: none;
}
.fancy_box_body {
border-radius: 0 0 15px 15px;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_1);
}
/* Section Headers */
.article-body__section {
text-transform: unset;
border-bottom: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
}
.article-body__section span {
border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
padding: 10px 20px;
line-height: 1.5em;
background-color: var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
}
/* Section Headers for review-article */
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section) {
position: relative;
border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
color: var(--brand-color-white);
}
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section),
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::before,
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::after {
background-color: var(--brand-color-1);
}
@media (min-width: 1000px) {
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::before {
left: -60px;
bottom: 0;
}
.pretty-review .review-article .text-copy h2:not(.featured__title):not(.article-body__section)::after {
right: -60px;
bottom: 0;
}
}
/* Byline Article Type Flag */
:is(.article, .review-article, .static-article, .news-article) .byline {
padding: 5px 10px;
--byline-chip--border-radius: 4px;
}
/* Sticky Jumplinks */
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"] {
border-bottom: none!important;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"].active {
background: var(--jumpto-underline-color);
border-radius: 20px;
margin: 5px 10px;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Inline:Link"].active a {
color: white!important;
}
[data-component-name="Article:JumpTo:Variants:Floating"] > div {
border: none !important;
border-radius: 15px !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_1) !important;
}
/* Topic tag links */
#articleTag nav a {
background: white !important;
border: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
color: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1) !important;
border-radius: 20px;
padding: 10px 15px !important;
}
/* Blockquote */
#article-body figure blockquote {
float: unset;
width: auto;
margin: 1.5em 0 !important;
border-top: none;
border-bottom: none;
border-left: 5px solid var(--flexi-secondary-color-1);
padding: 0 0 0 20px;
}
#article-body figure blockquote:before {
display:none;
}
#article-body figure blockquote > p {
font-size: 1.25em;
}
/* Person */
.person--separator {
border: none;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales-color-1);
border-radius: 15px;
padding: 20px;
}
.person--separator .person__role {
margin-top: 6px;
}
/* Author Block */
.author {
border: none !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales-color-1);
border-radius: 15px;
padding: 20px;
}
.author__heading {
display: flex !important;
flex: auto;
justify-content: start;
flex-direction: row !important;
align-items: center !important;
flex-wrap: wrap;
gap: 0px;
}
.author__role {
order: 100;
flex: 100%;
}
/* Dividers */
#article-body hr {
border-bottom: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1);
margin: 1em 0;
}
/* Reviews */
.pretty-verdict {
margin-top: 45px!important;
border: 2px solid var(--flexi-secondary_color_1)!important;
border-radius: 15px!important;
}
.pretty-verdict__heading-container {
top: -55px!important;
background: var(--flexi-secondary_color_1)!important;
color: white!important;
border-radius: 15px 15px 0 0!important;
}
/* Livefeed */
.widget-content-parsed-live-feed .article-body .wcp-item-content {
border-color: unset !important;
border-style: unset !important;
border-width: unset !important;
border-top: unset !important;
border-radius: 15px !important;
background: var(--flexi-grayscales-color-2);
}
/* Tables */
.table__wrapper--inbodyContent .table__head__heading {
background: var(--flexi-secondary-color-1)!important;
color: white!important;
}
.table__wrapper--inbodyContent .table__body__row:nth-child(2n) .table_body__data {
background: var(--flexi-grayscales_color_2)!important;
}
.table__wrapper--inbodyContent.table__wrapper--divider .table__head__heading:first-of-type, .table__wrapper--inbodyContent.table__wrapper--divider .table_body__data:first-of-type {
border-right: none!important;
}
/* Header adjustments */
@media (max-width: 699px) {
body.sticky-navigation .primary-nav {
width: 100% !important;
max-width: 100%;
}
}
[aria-label="Main navigation"] {
max-width: 1280px !important;
}
[aria-label="Main navigation"] > [data-component-name],
[aria-label="Main navigation"] > #auth-in-nav-header { /*no :is when selector has an #id - messes up the rules order*/
padding: 0 !important;

}
/* the site config key is ignored */
